title: FX Brief — 03 Sep 2026
intro:
Aggressive JPY appreciation dominates as broad-based unwinding of carry trades accelerates amid potential Bank of Japan policy shift speculation.
💪 CURRENCY RANKING
JPY +1.80% — Strongest performer as carry unwind intensifies; all crosses hemorrhaging 135-248 bps
CAD +0.44% — Oil bid supporting loonie; outperforming amid USD weakness and commodity strength
AUD +0.26% — Modest gains despite Asia risk-off tone; holding above 0.71 handle on China optimism
EUR +0.07% — Marginally firmer vs dollar but bleeding against yen; ECB dovish tilt capping upside
CHF +0.06% — Safe haven demand offset by profit-taking after recent rally; stuck in neutral
USD -0.25% — Broad weakness as DXY falters; Fed pause expectations weighing on greenback momentum
GBP -0.18% — Underperforming majors on stale UK data; cable rejected at 1.35 resistance zone
NZD -0.67% — Weakest alongside yen strength; RBNZ rate cut speculation and dairy weakness pressuring kiwi
